question: What are the most influential papers on CRISPR gene editing? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on CRISPR gene editing, based on citation counts, include foundational protocols for genome engineering, methods for programmable base editing, and large-scale knockout screening techniques.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1038/nprot.2013.143","title":"Genome engineering using the CRISPR-Cas9 system","citation_count":10374},{"doi":"10.1038/nature17946","title":"Programmable editing of a target base in genomic DNA without double-stranded DNA cleavage","citation_count":4849},{"doi":"10.1126/science.1247005","title":"Genome-Scale CRISPR-Cas9 Knockout Screening in Human Cells","citation_count":4738},{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2013.04.025","title":"One-Step Generation of Mice Carrying Mutations in Multiple Genes by CRISPR/Cas-Mediated Genome Engineering","citation_count":3183},{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2013.08.021","title":"Double Nicking by RNA-Guided CRISPR Cas9 for Enhanced Genome Editing Specificity","citation_count":3046}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on CRISPR gene editing, based on citation counts, include foundational protocols for genome engineering, methods for programmable base editing, and large-scale knockout screening techniques.
